_comment: Copy me, rename after the ride, fill in. Files starting with _ never render. Full field notes live in src/data/rides.js.
name: Ride Name
subtitle: The one-line hook under the title
_organizer: Who ran the ride — a club, a dealer, an event. Leave it out for your own rides and it reads "Self", and nothing is shown. organizerLogo is a public/ path and is OPTIONAL: every place that shows an organizer reads fine from the name alone, and a path that 404s falls back to name-only rather than a broken image.
_time: What the ride ACTUALLY took. Clock, H:MM, QUOTED — "1:45" shows as "1hr 45mins", "0:45" as "45mins". Unquoted 1:45 is invalid JSON and breaks the whole garage. null until ridden.
_estimateTime: What the route SHOULD take. Leave null — the detail page works it out from the router for the stops below. Set it (same format) only to override.
_place: fromPlace/destPlace are WHERE EXACTLY — a village, a showroom, a temple. fromCity/destCity are WHICH TOWN it belongs to. Sidebars show "Place, City"; cards and map headers show the city alone. State either, both or neither — they fall back to each other, and to the first/last stop label.
_roundtrip: dest* is WHERE THE RIDE WAS GOING, not where it stops. On a one-way ride those are the same place and there is nothing to think about. On a LOOP — same place at both ends of `stops` — they are not: name the turnaround here, and mark its stop "dest": true below. Where the ride FINISHES is derived (endPlace/endCity), so nothing about the finish is authored. See the ROUND TRIPS note in src/data/rides.js.
description: The short blurb on the ride card.
story: The write-up on the detail page.
_compliments: What the ride COMES WITH — breakfast, a badge, a lucky draw. Plain strings or {icon,text}; the icon is an emoji written verbatim and an entry without one gets a tick. Drawn on the detail page as a poster panel, skipped entirely when empty — which is most rides.
_stops: Start → any stops to route through → end. Two or more puts the ride on both maps; fewer means no route to draw. `dir` is which side the pin's label sits on. `icon` is what kind of place it is — temple, home, office, showroom, restaurant, hotel, shop, beach, fuel, waterfall, fort, station… (full list: PLACE_ICONS in pages/GarageV7RideDetail.jsx). An emoji works verbatim. Omit it and the stop gets a lettered pin instead. "dest": true marks THE POINT OF THE RIDE on a loop — the turnaround. Ignored on a one-way ride, where the destination is just the last stop.
